title: 把名字留给明天

source.prompt: Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 96 BPM, stately but intimate main theme for two young travelers remembering their lost family. A short noble pulse lead statement, tender woodwind answer, quiet march texture, gradually open into hopeful harmony. No trailer drums or huge climax. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: four-bar-multiple pulse alignment and two-beat chroma/timbre/energy window search; cosine equal-gain overlap

rhythm.note: Algorithmic pulse estimate; musical beat/meter and perceived loop coherence require listening.
